result.instructions: Tools for Patreon, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show my tiers and how many patrons each one has."; "Which patrons joined my campaign in the last 30 days?"; "List my five most recent posts and which ones are paid.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Patreon data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run patreon_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run patreon_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run patreon_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. patreon_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: patreon_get_identity
tools.title: Get my Patreon profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in Patreon user: name, profile URL and id. If the user owns a creator campaign, the campaign is included. Good first call to find the campaign id. Patreon: GET /identity.

tools.name: patreon_list_campaigns
tools.title: List my campaigns
tools.description: List the creator campaigns the signed-in user owns, with their tiers (price levels) and patron counts. Patreon: GET /campaigns (needs the campaigns scope).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: meta.pagination.cursors.next from the previous page.

tools.name: patreon_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Return one campaign by id: name, summary, patron count, pay-per-name and its tiers. Patreon: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}.

campaign_id.description: Patreon id: a campaign id (patreon_list_campaigns) or a post id (patreon_list_posts).

tools.name: patreon_list_members
tools.title: List campaign members
tools.description: List the patrons (members) of a campaign: patron status, lifetime support, current entitlement, last and next charge dates and their tiers. Names can be empty when a patron hides them. Email and address are not returned. Patreon: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/members (needs campaigns.members).

campaign_id.description: Patreon id: a campaign id (patreon_list_campaigns) or a post id (patreon_list_posts).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: meta.pagination.cursors.next from the previous page.

tools.name: patreon_get_member
tools.title: Get a campaign member
tools.description: Return one membership by member id (a UUID, not the user id): patron status, charge history fields and current tiers. Patreon: GET /members/{member_id} (needs campaigns.members).

tools.name: patreon_list_posts
tools.title: List campaign posts
tools.description: List the posts of a campaign with title, URL, publish date and access flags (public, paid). Post bodies are not included: use patreon_get_post. Patreon: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/posts (needs campaigns.posts).

campaign_id.description: Patreon id: a campaign id (patreon_list_campaigns) or a post id (patreon_list_posts).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: meta.pagination.cursors.next from the previous page.

tools.name: patreon_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Return one post by id, including its HTML content and access flags. Patreon: GET /posts/{id} (needs campaigns.posts).

post_id.description: Patreon id: a campaign id (patreon_list_campaigns) or a post id (patreon_list_posts).
